answer: Every identity must forge its own proof in the open - like a forge on an island, its fire visible on the horizon from far away. Honest forges burn at different times, at different heats, shaping different metal: each smith works their own way. A farm's forges all burn at once - same heat, same shape, same smoke - because one hand lit them all. The network watches the horizon and sees the synchronized glow, then quarantines the whole island. To pass, a farm must light a different forge for every sockpuppet, each burning its own way - as expensive as honest work.
